purpose: Add an app-owned POD execution-plan builder for a Goal5339 command-ready mapped-candidate packet. The plan rewrites local packet paths into remote POD paths and emits wrapper-only upload/execute/download/comparator steps.

pod_usage.reason: This goal builds an execution plan only. It does not run preflight, upload, remote commands, downloads, or comparison.

allowed_summary: Goal5343 adds a wrapper-only POD execution-plan builder for future mapped-candidate command-ready packets. It prevents naked SSH/SCP drift and keeps execution/comparison in later goals.
not_allowed: claiming author or RTDL commands were executed
claiming outputs were downloaded or compared
